description: This file defines the SpringNotificationEventPublisher class which implements notification event publishing in a Spring application. It uses Spring's ApplicationEventPublisher to broadcast NotificationEvent objects based on NotificationData.

classes.name: SpringNotificationEventPublisher
classes.description: A Spring service class that publishes notification events when broadcastNotification is called.

methods.name: broadcastNotification
methods.description: Publishes a NotificationEvent containing NotificationData using Spring's ApplicationEventPublisher.
